Modern text embeddings: Reimers and Gurevych (2019), Sentence-BERT, and Wang et al. (2022), Text Embeddings by Weakly-Supervised Contrastive Pre-training, illustrate transformer encoders and training with related text pairs. The closing diagram shows a common approach, not OpenAI’s specific architecture or training recipe.

For an API example, see OpenAI’s vector embeddings guide (checked October 27, 2026). A request supplies text and an embedding model; the response includes one vector for each supplied text. This runs the trained model rather than training a new model for each request.
